scope: SIA 380/2 dynamic room heating and cooling needs
SIA 4010 Test 1 sensible heating and cooling
SIA 4010 Test 1 room air and operative temperatures
SIA 4010 Test 2 total room solar heat gain

sensible_heating_power.qualification_limit: The ResultsReader identity, unit and timestep contract are confirmed. Physical compliance is established only by comparison with the official SIA 4010 Test 1 reference results.

sensible_cooling_power.qualification_limit: The ResultsReader identity, unit and timestep contract are confirmed. Physical compliance is established only by comparison with the official SIA 4010 Test 1 reference results.

total_room_solar_heat_gain_power.qualification_limit: The ResultsReader identity, unit and timestep contract are confirmed. Equivalence with the SIA 4010 total-room-solar-heat-gain alternative must be demonstrated with the official Test 2 diagnostic and reference results.

room_air_temperature.qualification_limit: The ResultsReader identity, unit, complete-year series and timestep contract are confirmed by the guarded Case 600 runtime probe. This binding does not validate the physical model.

operative_temperature.qualification_limit: The ResultsReader identity, unit, complete-year series and timestep contract are confirmed by the guarded Case 600 runtime probe. IES documents dry resultant temperature as operative temperature in still-air conditions; Test 1 has no ventilation system. This binding does not validate the physical model.

total_transmitted_solar_radiation.reason: The probe exposed a surface-level transmittance property without a qualified power series. Test 2 uses the allowed total-solar-heat-gain alternative instead.

all_other_probe_candidates.reason: Outside the current SIA 380/2 and SIA 4010 Test 1/Test 2 extraction contract.
